batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c KL Rahul b MC Henriques

batting.name: DT Christian
batting.dismissal: c SN Khan b MC Henriques

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c SN Khan b Mohammed Shami

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c HV Patel b Shahbaz Ahmed

batting.name: MA Agarwal
batting.dismissal: c Mohammed Siraj b YS Chahal

batting.name: N Pooran
batting.dismissal: c D Padikkal b YS Chahal

batting.name: AK Markram
batting.dismissal: c DT Christian b GHS Garton

balls.text: yorker again, and he makes room and strikes this towards cover. They scamper a single

yorker again and now we have Mohammed Shami on a hat-trick! Garton shuffles across looking for the same region as Shahbaz. He's just reducing the target for Shami to hit, who's spearing them in like ICBMs at the moment. Superb stuff from Shami. If only Punjab had seen a few of these yorkers earlier on when ABD and Maxwell were going strong!
full, and strikes timber. This was too quick for Shahbaz, who had walked across his stumps and was looking to just paddle this around the corner
short, and slapped away outside the ground through the midwicket region. SMACK! Rahul has a look of bemusement
short, outside off, and he has slashed this looking to go down the ground. Goes straight up, and into Sarfaraz's waiting hands at point
cutter, slashed away towards third man
short, and he waits for it. Goes deep inside the crease and slaps this behind square. Maxwell is switched on from the start today!
taken on the full, and driven towards wide long on
slower ball, outside off, and he drags a pull towards long on
gone wide again, and Maxwell has a swish at it. Rahul celebrates a wicket, but that's been given wide. Bat goes on to hit ground, actually, the replays reveal
tossed up wide, and full, but just beyond the tramlines. Idea was right, but at this stage you don't want to be bowling extra balls to a well-set Maxwell
length, change of pace, and he waits on it. Cuts this fiercely just beyond the reach of backward point. Deep point gets to his left and allows the second

sliced away towards cover, and there's a direct hit. That will be out, I think. Fullish length, outside off, and he hit it quite firmly. Had no option but to go, and is caught short by a sharp throw from Sarfaraz Khan
fullish length, but fails to make the yorker. Straight down the wicket, and that has struck the roof of the pavillion!
looks for the full ball, down the leg side. Seems to have come off the pad, as he shapes to sweep. They pinch a leg bye before short fine leg can get to it
googly again, and cramps him for room. Chopped back on to the ground
steps away and punches this to long off, and brings up his FIFTY
wow! Innovation max from Maxwell. He sets up for the reverse hit, and in the process Bishnoi throws it flatter and towards leg side. He just switches hands, and flogs it over the cover area
length, closer to the stumps, and driven towards cover
length, towards middle and leg, and he has flat-batted this through towards deep midwicket. They scamper two again
this is deposited over long on! Length again from Shami, as he probably seeks the yorker. Closer to AB this time, and he gets enough time to clear his front leg and just go straight down the ground
that is vintage ABD! Mid off inside the circle, and he puts it on a good length, outside off. AB can just drive this between mid-off and cover
full, around off, and he slaps this hard towards deep point
full, outside off, and he drives this firmly, but to the extra cover around the edge of the circle
length, outside off, and he seems to have pre-meditated a hoick towards midwicket. Eventually smashed towards long on for a single
fullish, but down the legside, and Maxwell whirs his wrists into action. Flicked away towards deep square leg
full, around leg and middle, just sliding down as it beats Maxwell who wants to punch it towards midwicket. Rolls away towards point
cutter again, around leg and middle, and punched down to long on
length, fetched from outside off, and flogged towards cow corner. There was a fielder inside the circle at midwicket, but appeared to not read it. Just bounced to the left of the fielder there
slower ball again, punched towards Brar at cover. Has a shy at the non-striker's end, but misses, and they pick an overthrow
smart bowling! Change of pace, and outside off. Maxwell has started backing off, and eventually can't reach it, beaten as much by the line as the lack of pace
seam up, driven towards cover. At the edge of the circle, and that will allow them to take one
cuts one away from outside off, towards the fielder at deep point
googly, from outside off, and he drives it back to the bowler
a touch wider and flatter, and he drives this towards deep point
six more! Straight down the ground. Bishnoi has gone too full again. Doesn't matter where it turns when it's in Maxwell's arc
googly, and he has latched on to this. Outside the ground again. Over midwicket. Maxwell indicates to AB that he picked the googly of the hand. Superb ball striking again!

flat, turns away from Maxwell, who wristily works it towards deep midwicket. They scamper two, and that is sensational running between the wickets! There's a direct hit at the striker's end, but he was well beyond the popping crease
length, angles in, and he punches this to extra cover. No run
full, around leg. He looks to have a swipe towards fine leg, but it comes off his pad
change up again, around off, and he punches this through the offside. The man at cover is a touch wide, and hence that allows them to pick up a quick single
length, punched hard, but straight back at the stumps. No touch from the bowler, though
fullish, around off and middle, driven with the incoming angle towards long on
change of pace, but full down the leg side, and he works it away towards fine leg
wide of off, and punched towards deep point for AB to retain strike
full, outside off, punched to long off

creamed over the midwicket region, and out of the ground! Another ball that is a touch too full, and allows him to go across the line with ease. Not a big turner of the ball, is Brar. So that makes it a safe shot
punches one through the offside. It was a length ball outside off, and he gets two to the right of Pooran at deep point
shorter in length, and Maxwell can go back and thrash this over the midwicket region. Just goes over the rope
length, punched away towards wide cover
length, comes back towards him from outside off. Tapped to point. Wants a single, but has to decide against it
fullish length, around off, punched back towards the bowler

full, looks to swipe this through the offside, and gets a fine tickle. Good catch by Rahul. Punjab have their man! A set batter goes for RCB. This could be a pivotal match-turning spell from Henriques
full, punched to long on
fuller length, just going down leg as Maxwell shuffles across to try and punch it away, but misses
length, and a touch of width. He can slap this hard towards sweeper cover
shuffles across and plays this towards deep backward square leg
length, punched to cover
drives a slightly wider ball towards deep point
defends a length ball back down the wicket
winds up for the reverse sweep, but fails to make contact. Struck outside the line of leg, one would think
length, taken an outside edge, and then struck Rahul's pad, I think. Just failed to get his gloves there. Through to short third man
back of a length on off, and angling into him. Flicked off his hips to deep backward square leg
on a hattrick! Sarfaraz at the hotspot at point, and he dives to pouch the catch. Fullish outside off. Christian throws his hands at this, slices it, and sharp, low catch.

big wicket! Keeper standing up. Henriques goes full on off. Tries to whip it over midwicket, but the ball stays low, goes under the blade, and hits off stump. Kohli looks at his bat, and goes back after a struggling innings
yorker length outside off. Dug away to mid off, and they scurry across for one
good length, outside off again. Tries to cut but mistimed. Ball rolls back to the bowler
full on off. Moving away. Padikkal goes low and then cuts late. Finds point
full on middle and off. Kohli wants to nudge it leg side but leading edge takes it back to the bowler
breaks the shackles in style! Brar goes full. Kohli gets down on one knee. And it's been swiped over deep midwicket. Into the crowd
full on middle, and pushed down the ground to midwicket
full on middle, and he goes deep before whipping it to midwicket. Kohli's strike-rate now under 100
good length on off. Goes onto the back foot and bunts it back to the bowler
trapped lbw? Maybe pitching outside leg. Good length ball, and he paddles it to short fine leg. No review available either
drilled to deep midwicket for one. Full outside off, and he drags a slog to the fielder on the boundary line
full outside off. Sharp turn in and inside edged onto his back leg. Rolls away to the off side for one
length ball turning away. Poked to short third man

has he reverse swept this into the keeper's gloves? Keeper-bowler appeal, umpire says no. KL Rahul reviews. Full on off and turning away. Padikkal looks to play this behind point. But Bishnoi bowls it quick, and it zips past the bat, goes past the glove on the way to Rahul. There was a spike off the glove but the TV umpire K Srinivasan says not out! KL Rahul and the fielders are asking the umpire Ananthapadmanabhan why that is not out. The spike was tiny when the ball was near the glove, but the spike was definitely there! Maybe the umpire thought the sound came from somewhere else. Punjab lose the review too
full on middle. Sharp turn across the bat's outside edge as he presses forward to defend
full outside off. Turning further away. Padikkal looks to cut but it zips past the bat
full on middle, and angling into leg. Misses the flick, hits the front pad. No lbw appeal since that's definitely going down leg
good length on middle. Angling across. Flicked from outside off to wide long on for a walking single
full on off. Padikkal rocks back and punches to Shahrukh at cover
good length on off. Nudges it down the ground to long on for one
good length on off. Punched to midwicket's left
around the stumps. The left-arm spinner goes full and wide outside off. Smacks a cut to point
good length outside off stump. Offers no shot, and sees the powerplay out. Time out
overpitched outside leg stump. Can't flick it away. Through to Rahul, and that's another extra run
misses the yorker by a few inches, and that's been put away. Flicks this very fine, and beats short fine leg for another boundary!
off cutter. Length ball on middle, and angling across. Tap and run to the off side. Team fifty
searching for another yorker. Lands just outside off. Dug away to cover, and Shahrukh at cover overruns it since the ball turns along the grass. Misfield allows them to pinch the run finally
slower ball yorker. Dips late, and drops near his toe. Dug away to the leg side
full toss outside off. Padikkal spots it early and smashes a shot right over Arshdeep's head. Off the sweet spot...
back of a length, offcutter. Opens the bat's face and fends it to point for a quick single

inside edge onto his pads. Good length ball on middle. He moves to the leg side to clip a shot over midwicket. Smacks it onto his body, and it rolls away to the off side for one. Kohli is disappointed that he could not put that away as he jogs across to the other end
vintage Kohli. Overpitched on leg, and he uses his wrists to whip a flick off his toes behind square. Too full, Shami pays the price
yorker. On middle, and he wedges a shot to short fine leg this time

dropped! Sarfaraz Khan could've dismissed his former IPL captain. Shortish outside off and Kohli hammers a pull to midwicket. Sarfaraz moves to his left and sticks two hands over his head. The ball hits his fingertip, and goes over him.
slower ball. Full outside off, and worked off his pads to midwicket
shoveled over the bowler's head. Extra air. Full on middle. And he gets under the ball to club the extra ball (courtesy the early wide) for another boundary
full on middle. The google keeps Padikkal in two minds. Pokes at it, but the ball is nowhere near the bat. Past the edge
full on middle. Sharp turn away as Padikkal goes onto the back foot. Just past the outside edge, and past off stump too
just short of six! Overpitched, on off, and Padikkal gets the bat behind the ball before it could turn. Thumped over mid on
dropped? Full outside off, and turning away. Padikkal looks to slog across the line. Past the edge, and it drops out of Rahul's hands again. Maybe there was an edge
full outside off, and driven to long off for a single

could've been stumped first ball! Length ball on middle, but the googly goes down the leg side. Kohli is coming down the track again, and is therefore in a muddle. But Rahul can't collect, and the ball bounces off his chest. Allows Kohli to get back
uses the bottom hand to wedge a shot over Markram at mid on. But the fielder, like in the previous over, commits to the chase, and manages to drag it back from inches inside the rope
full outside off. Rolls his fingers over the ball. Soft hand push to Sarfaraz at cover
good length outside off. Stays on the back foot and nudges it to point
good length just outside off. Fends it off the back foot, ball rolling back past Kohli
full outside leg stump. Going down the leg side, and wide given.
full outside off stump. Throws his bat at this for a cover drive. But ends up slicing it, and the ball goes over point for four more. Not in control, but he'll take it
welcomed with a six! Full around leg stump. Comes down the ground and gently whips it to the leg side. Soars into the stands on the on side
pristine! Full just outside off, and he drills a drive past Markram at mid off. But the fielder gives it a mighty chase, gets close to the ball, and then slides to stop the four at long off
good length, on middle and leg. Worked off his hips to deep midwicket for one
full on off. Closes the bat's face and works it to midwicket for a quick single
slower one. Full just outside leg stump. Inside edges a flick onto his pad and it rolls away. Henriques at short fine leg runs around to cut it off.
short ball on leg. He ducks under quickly but then bounce is not too much. Through to Rahul
good length outside off. Cut through the off side to the man in the deep
full on off. Stays on the back foot, and defended to cover
short and wide again. Backs away to cut but mistimed. Rolls away to point
around the stumps. Good length outside off. Cut square to cover point
length ball turning in. Worked off his pads to square leg for a single
punishes the half-tracker this time. Lands on off stump. Turns into Kohli. Enough time to swivel and whip it through square leg for four
full on leg, and clipped off his toes to short fine leg
full, and pumped towards deep midwicket
slower, length, and deposited deep into the stands beyond midwicket!
fuller, slower, and worked away towards deep midwicket. They get two, but this will suffice for RCB
slower, wider, and driven towards deep backward point
fullish length. Slapped back down the wicket, but long on gets to his right quickly and cuts off the boundary
fuller ball. Dropped at his feet, and they run for the single. Harshal runs in his follow through and underarms this into the stumps. Shahrukh gone!
slashed, and past short third. But Garton gets across from deep backward point to slide in and save the boundary!
fuller, but straighter. Can only drive it down to long off
full toss, swinging further away. Called a wide! Shahrukh threw the kitchen sink and some other parts as well at it, but failed to make it

full again, just outside off. Shahrukh has a big heave. Siraj appeals, as does Bharat. And they have taken the review. Was a scrambled seam delivery, and there's definitely a slight noise not far from when the ball passses the bat, but there's nothing on UltraEdge
looks to go full, but ends up going a touch wide. Shahrukh has an almighty heave, but gets a streaky four to the right of short third
full, and he squirts it away from outside off. Good stop by short third, diving away to his left. Important thing is, Shahrukh has strike again
length, wide outside off. Henriques looks to go down the ground, but fails to make any contact
slower ball, but full in length. He looks for another big hit, but loses shape. In the end, his bottom hand comes off, as the ball sneaks under the bat. Line was outside off, thankfully
length, and he has slapped this over the midwicket region. Onto the canopy and beyond! The key was anticipating the slower ball and staying deep in the crease. Clocked at 92 m by the broadcasters!
slower, but fuller. Drives firmly, and Kohli at extra cover dives to his right to cut it off
slower ball, just around off, cutting back in. Henriques wasn't very sure about it. In the end, just a feeble waft at it, as it goes past him, and just over off stump!
down the wicket, length ball met with a firm drive down towards long on
slower, just outside off, and he has worked it away through the cow corner region. Not off the middle, though, and it's to the shorter side of the ground. They are able to scamper two
slower ball again, towards back of a length, and he swivel-pulls this towards deep midwicket
length, outside off, and a slower one. Markram looks for that second boundary, but toe-ends it. Christian runs in and completes the catch this time
back of a length, outside off, to the right of cover and they pinch a single
short, and he has a heave at this too. There's a man stationed at square leg, and this has gone really quickly to him, along the ground
length, and he has gone long down the wicket. Christian runs in from long on, but cannot get to it despite diving forward.
back of a length, slower ball, and Markram has a heave. Off the inside edge, but it has run away towards deep backward square for four

just out of reach for a return catch! Chahal has really made the ball talk in this final over. This again pitches around leg and turns across. Shahrukh looks to work it away on the onside. Off the outside edge, and just out of reach of a diving Chahal, away to his left

perfect legbreak! Well, Sarfaraz is no Mike Gatting, but his baffelement is reminiscent of what happened in the 1993 Ashes! Tossed well up, pitches around leg, turns across him and takes the top of off. It's almost as if the batter was never there. You have to feel sorry for Sarfaraz. That would have castled the best of batters in prime form
flatter, towards leg stump, and pushed to long on

length, and he goes straight down the wicket. Not far from Christian at long off, but he has got enough on this. Tossed up, and a regulation legbreak. There's not a lot of turn on offer today, and that has allowed batters to go straight down the ground often

Mayank is gone! Bizarre way to get out, to say the least. Sets himself up for the sweep, and ends up getting it off the under edge. Beaten by the lack of pace on that regulation legbreak. Pops up in the air just to the right of Bharat, and Siraj runs around from short third to complete the catch
googly, and he chips this in the air, but on a couple of bounces towards long on
fullish, outside off, and driven down to long off
length, but width on offer. Markram slashes this away towards deep point. No fielder there, and that gets him four more
short, bashed away towards deep midwicket. Fetches it from just outside off
Mayank looks to go down the ground, but gets a streaky four away to third. Off the edge, to a fullish ball just outside off. Third is insdie the circle and that helps him
length, angles into him, and he looks to go through the onside. The bat turns a touch, and he gets it towards deep square leg
length from Siraj, punched on the up, but straight to extra cover inside the circle
slower ball again, close to the body. He steers this to the left of short fine leg and picks up a single
slower ball again, wide of off. Markram is beaten by the pace of it, as he looks to punch this through the off side. Way away from the ball in the end
cutter, goes under the bat as Markram has a waft at it, looking to go across the line. Misses the top of off, as well as the inside edge, on its way through to Bharat
length, punched hard, but there's a short cover in place now for the new man
short, and he rocks back to pull this away towards deep midwicket. There's AB in the deep, and keeps the scoring down to just the single
pace up, around off, and driven towards cover
fullish, around leg, and driven firmly towards long on
tossed up, and he looks for the sweep. Cannot keep it down, and Chahal gets his man. Straight down Padikkal's throat at deep backward square. Just gets it off the toe-end of the bat
length, worked back towards the bowler with the turn in from around middle and leg
flighted, outside off, and played with the turn towards sweeper cover. Fifty for Mayank
tossed up, wide again. The idea seems right, but the radar isn't
wrong 'un, and full enough to allow him to put away a sweep towards deep backward square
length, punched towards deep cover
tossed up, but wide of off. Too wide, in fact
slower ball, around the pads, and he works it away towards deep midwicket
tries to run a slower one down towards third man. Cuts back into him and tucks him for room. Cannot get it too far away
fuller, and he jams the bat down in time to defend it back to the bowler
slower, outside off, and he looks to go for the drive. Off the outside edge, away towards third man
back of a length, pace up, and he is forced to defend this towards mid on. Bowled from well wide of the crease
length, from around the wicket, and defended. A change up in pace as well
flighted outside off, and driven towards deep cover

no 100 partnership this time for Punjab Kings! Rahul looks to skip down the wicket and go straight down the wicket. The ball just grips enough to take the outside edge and goes as an easy take for short third
length, around leg, and he has worked it away towards deep midwicket
tossed up, and smoked back down the wicket. Goes a bit inside out after clearing his front leg, and gets it waaaaaaay over long off
tossed up a touch wide, and he cuts this hard. Deep point will get across to it, but not before that they come back for a comfortable two
works a length blal around leg towards midwicket and hands over the strike to Mayank
up and over! Tosses it up again. He clears the front leg and muscles the ball straight down. Two fielders in the deep tried to congregate but failed
full on off. Skiddy. Cut to cover point but close to the bat
good length, on middle. Tapped to point off the back foot
flighted. Full and wide outside off. His preferred shot, inside out over cover! Played with the turn, and that had a boundary written on it as long as he cleared the infield
full on middle stump. Skips forward and flicks to midwicket. Nobody there, fielder from the deep runs in
fullish, on off stump. Smothers a push to cover
fullish, outside off stump. Taps it late to short third man, and off they go for one
full on middle. Presses forward and fends it right back
good length outside off. Cuts in front of square off the back foot. Straight to Kohli at cover
full on leg. Down on one knee, tries to sweep fine. Misses, hits the boot and rolls away to short fine leg
full outside off. Bit of extra air. Driven past the bowler to long off
full outside off, and pushed to deep point. Two on offer, and comfortably taken
slower ball, back of a length, angling in, and Mayank picks the pace perfectly. Waits on the back foot for ages, and when its near his eyeline he thumps a pull behind square where there's a big gap
full outside off. Flays a drive through the off side to the deep
full on middle and leg. Works it to midwicket, and the fielder has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end. Not a direct hit
full on middle. He backs away and then smacks an inside out drive to long off
full on leg stump. Mayank bends his knees, and flicks this comfortably over short fine leg! Plays it in a paddled manner, not a whippy manner
offcutter. Half-tracker on middle. Rahul backs away and slaps behind point to the fielder in the deep
full on middle. Comes down the track and drives to long on for a single
full outside off. Taps it through the big off-side gap. Deep point runs in to cut off the second but he's unsuccessful
full on middle. Clears the front leg and clobbers a shot to long on for a single
full on leg stump. Tries to flick, can't connect. Hits the pad and rolls away to short fine leg
full on middle. Inside out drive to long off
full on off, and he wants to tap it leg side but the leading edge takes it to the off side
back of a length, slower ball too. Spongy bounce, and he pulls to deep backward square leg

nearly caught! Slower ball, length outside off. Mayank presses forward to defend, but meets the ball with hard hands. Pops off the bat, but Harshal can't take a one-handed catch running diagonally forward
good length outside off. Stands tall, and crunches a cut. But cover point is on the circle
slower ball. Full on leg, and worked through midwicket to the fielder in the deep
yorker length. Just outside off. Pushed to the off side but they can't take a run. That's because Harshal scurries across to intercept the ball off his own bowling
good length on middle. Goes deep in his crease and whips it to deep backward square leg
full just outside off. Turning away. Nudged to cover point off the front foot

stumping appeal down the leg side and they are going upstairs. Full on middle, and going down the leg side as he misses the flick. Bharat with the glovework, but Agarwal's back leg is inside the crease. The TV umpire is now checking for caught-behind, and there's none, but the ball did graze his thigh
wristwork! Full outside off. Bit of turn away. Mayank presses forward and places the drive between cover and cover point
full on middle and leg. Driven to long off for a single
welcomed with a six! Tosses it up outside off stump from around the wickets. Clears the front leg, gets the bat down in one swift movement, and that's been clobbered into the sightscreen
fullish outside off, and driven to cover point. Siraj is behind it
slower ball, around the stumps again. Full on off stump. Rahul walks across to the off side, exposing all stumps, before mistiming a sweep to the gap between short fine leg and square leg
back of a length from around the stumps. Angling into him, swivels to pull, but it's in the air. Lands around the square leg umpire. No-ball since its the second bouncer
full on middle. Full face of the bat and driven back past the stumps
slower ball, full outside leg stump. Gently tapped past the bowler's right to mid on
pace! Short ball, and wide given for height. Garton cranked it up this ball. Agarwal doesn't even need to duck because of the bounce
good length ball outside leg stump. Clipped off his hips to deep backward square leg. Calls early for the two
muscled! Back of a length around leg stump. Mayank opens his stance to access the leg side and then pulls it confidently over square leg for six
full on middle. Wants to flick it through the on side but the shot ricochets onto his pad

given out! And Rahul reviews straight away. Is there an inside edge? Another full ball, offcutter jagging in. Rahul looks to work it leg side but beaten by the slower ball. Hits his back leg, but replays suggest an inside edge. Umpire Illingworth gets it wrong. A howler averted.

hits the billboard at wide long on! Offcutter, 127kph, on off stump, and Rahul hammers it over the leg side. Hits the "we salute all frontline workers" board in the ground, and the broadcasters say that's 101m long!
yorker length, around leg stump. Dug away to mid on
fullish, just outside off. Defended back
short and wide. Rahul throws his hands at it. Slashed hard, past short third man!
slower ball again. Nearly a yorker. Caresses a gentle drive to backward point with the bat's open face
back of a length and he plays a controlled pull. Struck to the big side of the boundary, and Agarwal is safe since it bounces well short of Harshal on the line
slower ball again. This time full on middle. Bunted to mid on, but no run
slower ball. But wayward. Full way outside leg stump. Mayank misses the flick attempt.
full on off. Bends his knee and cuts it ti point. Straight to Padikkal manning the region

arm or glove? Short ball on leg. He tries to pull, but it hits the body and goes to the keeper. Appeal turned down and do they review? No review after a chat between Kohli, Bharat, Chahal and Garton. Good decision - it came off the forearm
length ball on middle and angling across. Mistimes a cut to point for one
full on leg stump. Looks to flick. Hits the boot and rolls away to short fine leg
fullish outside off. Prods forward to tap a defensive shot to the off side
good length ball jags in sharply from off stump. Tucked to the leg side, off his pads
good length ball angling in, and he controls a punched shot through the off side to deep point
good length, width offered again. Cut square, but finds cover point
Siraj goes full and wide first ball. Rahul gets his 285th run against RCB without getting dismissed by thumping it to deep point
